profile.headline: Software Engineer & Researcher
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer and researcher who specializes in putting clean solutions around messy problems.

positions.title: Application Innovator
positions.description: Full-stack dev, primarily on apps for security professionals
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Angular · PostgreSQL · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: I did research in the Center for Nonlinear Analysis surrounding the mathematical physics of surfactants and the calculus of surfaces.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description: I worked on programming language extraction (that is, the process of turning code into a database that can be queried using CodeQL) and wrote some security-related CodeQL queries.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I did research on algorithms for Hydro-Particle Mesh (HPM) simulations.  I studied the effects of different theoretical distribution functions of particles on the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) of simulation data, then compared the results to our real simulations to find a new function that better represents the DFT of our results for the purpose of deconvolution.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Theoretical Computer Science and Theoretical Physics

volunteerExperiences.description: Four annual week-long trips to Baytown, Texas to help build houses.
